roles.title: Security Researcher
roles.summary: Working as a Security Analyst at Eminence Ways Pvt. Ltd., delivering offensive security assessments and strengthening the security posture of enterprise clients.
highlights: Conduct end to end Web Application Penetration Testing across enterprise platforms, validating findings with manual techniques and proof of concept development.
Perform API Security Assessments covering authentication, authorization, and business logic flaws in mission critical services.
Execute Mobile Application Security Testing on iOS and Android targets, including traffic analysis and binary review.
Carry out Thick Client Penetration Testing across production and staging infrastructure.
Deliver structured reporting with risk analysis, remediation guidance, and client ready technical documentation.
Align assessments with OWASP Top 10, secure development principles, and industry best practices.
